newsitem.title: UK: Misys to buy firms for up to 36.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Misys to buy firms for up to 36.6 mln stg.

text.p: British computer systems developer Misys Plc said on Tuesday it would buy Summit Systems Inc and a firm holding a stake in that company in acquisitions totalling a maximum of 36.6 million stg.
Summit is owned by Finance Information et Technologie SA, which has about 31.6 percent of the company, with private individuals owning the remaining 68.4 percent, Misys said in a statement.
Under the agreements, Misys said it would also buy Finance Information and thereby acquire that firm's 40 percent stake in Misys's Quotient France SA unit.
Misys currently owned 60 percent of Quotient, a French company that sells New York-based Summit's financial derivatives trading software package.

In addition to the 36.6 million stg, Misys said it planned to make incentive compensation payments up to a maximum of 11.2 million stg to certain Summit and Quotient employees upon satisfaction of certain conditions.
Misys said it would also pay about 363,000 stg of transaction costs.
The company said it would pay for the acquisitions with existing resources and a new banking facility.
Misys shares gained 7.5p to 1087.5p by 0815 GMT.
